title: Remove Settings runtime restart flat exports
summary: Removed the two transitional flat Settings runtime restart helper aliases while preserving the helpers on mediaPipelineSettingsView.
reason: WebView flat export cleanup remains an active opportunistic workstream. The runtime restart helpers already have namespace consumers in settingsWizard.js and no remaining direct flat consumers, so their direct window aliases can be retired safely.
behavior_before: settingsView.js exposed settingsRuntimeRestartConfirmationLine and settingsRuntimeRestartNoticeLines both through mediaPipelineSettingsView and as direct window.* compatibility aliases.
behavior_after: settingsRuntimeRestartConfirmationLine and settingsRuntimeRestartNoticeLines remain available through mediaPipelineSettingsView, and settingsWizard.js continues to call that namespace. The direct window.* aliases are no longer created, and the global export inventory and WebView public contract baseline now report 468 flat exports.
tests_added: tests.webview.test_webview_handbrake_settings_ui.WebViewHandBrakeSettingsUiTests.test_settings_runtime_restart_helpers_are_namespace_only_exports asserts namespace access remains, settingsWizard.js consumes the namespace, and direct flat aliases are absent.
manual_validation: Baseline targeted test failed before source edit because window.settingsRuntimeRestartConfirmationLine still existed.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet to restore the two Settings direct window.* aliases, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline, godfile map, split candidates, global export inventory, summaries, and restore the flat export count from 468 to 470.
